items.detail: The **Nasdaq fell 1.13% to 26,936** and the S&P 500 lost 0.75% to 7,706, surrendering Tuesday's record close.
items.why: Treasury yields spiked after flash PMIs showed the fastest private-sector growth in more than five years.

items.detail: The **10-year Treasury yield leapt to 5.13%**, its highest since July 2007, while the five-year cleared 5% for the first time since then.
items.why: A weak five-year auction, hawkish remarks from Fed Governor Barr and a 2% rise in oil all pushed yields up.

items.detail: Stock futures were flat early Thursday with **WTI crude back above $103** a barrel after Wednesday's selloff.
items.why: The US-Iran war keeps supply tight, feeding the inflation fears now driving the bond market.

items.detail: **Hong Kong's Hang Seng fell 0.6%** on Thursday, its tech gauge down 1%, while Japan's Nikkei jumped 1.5% after a holiday.
items.why: Surging global bond yields hit risk assets before the Trump-Xi summit; Washington extended the China trade truce two months.

items.detail: The **Sensex dropped about 600 points** on Thursday and the Nifty tested 23,200, erasing Wednesday's advance.
items.why: Brent above $102 and the US 10-year at 5.11% hurt sentiment in an oil-importing market.

items.detail: The **Russell 2000 sank 1.60%**, worst of the US majors, wiping out Tuesday's gain with barely one in six members higher.
items.why: US small caps carry more floating-rate debt, so the five-year yield clearing 5% hits them hardest.

items.detail: **Bitcoin broke below $84,000**, giving back Tuesday's eight-month high, as **$510 million** of crypto positions were liquidated.
items.why: Hot US survey data drove the 10-year yield to 5.1%, draining money from assets that pay no yield.

items.detail: **Ether slid to about $2,676**, handing back most of Tuesday's 5% jump.
items.why: US spot ether funds still added coins on Wednesday, so the drop came from the yield shock, not fund selling.

items.detail: **Solana eased to roughly $114**, down from $118.56 on Tuesday and off its highest level since January.
items.why: Solana ETF inflows collapsed 96% in a week to $6.18 million, removing the bid behind the rally.

items.detail: **Spot gold fell 1.2% to about $4,304 an ounce**, a third straight session lower, with silver down 3%.
items.why: A dollar index above 100 and the 10-year yield at a 19-year high made the non-yielding metal less appealing.

crossCuttingTheme: A 19-year high in the 10-year Treasury yield, after hot US PMIs, was the day's single lever: it knocked tech and small caps, pulled Asian and Indian stocks lower, sent bitcoin under $84,000 and firmed the dollar against gold.
